firstPlayerRule: Choose the starting player randomly. If you just played a game of Dominion that did not end in a tie, the previous winner plays last and the player to their left starts.
clarifications: Intrigue's second edition requires the basic cards and rulebook supplied by Dominion; the starting instruction comes from those base rules.
The earlier standalone first edition is not the edition reviewed here.
